summary: More ansible-core 2.19 breaking changes: omit placeholders no longer leak from loop items (use | default(omit)), modules can't use sys.excepthook, plugins must tag templates as trusted, Jinja plugins must opt in to undefined arguments or Marker values, FactCache is removed, and serializing unfinished omit values with to_json, to_yaml or ansible-inventory fails.
questions: Why does omit not work in my loop items anymore?
What is a MarkerError in Ansible?
Why does to_json fail with omit?
Do custom plugins need to trust templates in 2.19?
